---- MODULE ZkV3_7_0 ----
EXTENDS ZkV3_7_0Defs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS

LOCAL AGFinite == INSTANCE FiniteSetTheorems

LEMMA AGCardBridge == \A S: Cardinality(S) = AGFinite!Cardinality(S)
BY DEF Cardinality, AGFinite!Cardinality

\* Typing and reciprocal membership of leader/follower clusters.
AGCluster ==
  /\ state \in [Server -> {LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING}]
  /\ zabState \in [Server -> {ELECTION, DISCOVERY, SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST}]
  /\ learners \in [Server -> SUBSET Server]
  /\ connectInfo \in [Server -> [sid: Server \cup {NullPoint},
       syncMode: {NONE, DIFF, TRUNC, SNAP}, nlRcv: BOOLEAN]]
  /\ \A s \in Server:
       /\ (state[s] /= FOLLOWING => connectInfo[s].sid = NullPoint)
       /\ (state[s] /= LEADING => learners[s] = {})
       /\ (state[s] = LEADING =>
            /\ s \in learners[s]
            /\ \A t \in learners[s] \ {s}:
                 /\ state[t] = FOLLOWING
                 /\ connectInfo[t].sid = s)
       /\ (state[s] = FOLLOWING /\ connectInfo[s].sid /= NullPoint =>
            \E t \in Server:
              /\ connectInfo[s].sid = t
              /\ state[t] = LEADING
              /\ s \in learners[t])

AGInv == AGCluster

LEMMA AGInit == Init => AGInv
BY NullPointNotServer, SMTT("r10")
 DEF NONE, DIFF, TRUNC, SNAP, Init, InitServerVars, InitServerVarsL, InitLeaderVars, InitLeaderVarsL,
     InitFollowerVars, AGInv, AGCluster, IsLeader, LOOKING,
     FOLLOWING, LEADING, ELECTION, DISCOVERY, SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST


\* The next two operators split the invariant for shutdown proofs.
AGShape ==
  /\ state \in [Server -> {LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING}]
  /\ zabState \in [Server -> {ELECTION, DISCOVERY, SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST}]
  /\ learners \in [Server -> SUBSET Server]
  /\ connectInfo \in [Server -> [sid: Server \cup {NullPoint},
       syncMode: {NONE, DIFF, TRUNC, SNAP}, nlRcv: BOOLEAN]]

AGNode(s) ==
  /\ (state[s] /= FOLLOWING => connectInfo[s].sid = NullPoint)
  /\ (state[s] /= LEADING => learners[s] = {})
  /\ (state[s] = LEADING =>
       /\ s \in learners[s]
       /\ \A t \in learners[s] \ {s}:
            /\ state[t] = FOLLOWING
            /\ connectInfo[t].sid = s)
  /\ (state[s] = FOLLOWING /\ connectInfo[s].sid /= NullPoint =>
       \E t \in Server:
         /\ connectInfo[s].sid = t
         /\ state[t] = LEADING
         /\ s \in learners[t])

LEMMA AGDisjoint ==
  AGInv => \A i,j \in Server:
    IsLeader(i) /\ IsLeader(j) /\ i /= j
      => learners[i] \cap learners[j] = {}
BY SMTT("r5")
 DEF AGInv, AGCluster, IsLeader, LEADING, FOLLOWING

LEMMA AGShutdownLeader ==
  ASSUME NEW i \in Server, AGInv, IsLeader(i), LeaderShutdown(i)
  PROVE AGInv'
<1>1. AGShape'
  <2>1. AGShape
    BY SMTT("r2") DEF AGInv, AGCluster, AGShape
  <2>2. QED
    BY <2>1, SMTT("r10")
     DEF AGShape, LeaderShutdown, ZabTimeoutInCluster, InitialConnectInfo
<1>2. ASSUME NEW s \in Server, s \in learners[i]
      PROVE AGNode(s)'
  BY <1>2, SMTT("r10")
   DEF AGInv, AGCluster, AGNode, IsLeader, LeaderShutdown,
       ZabTimeoutInCluster, InitialConnectInfo, LEADING, FOLLOWING,
       LOOKING
<1>3. ASSUME NEW s \in Server, s \notin learners[i]
      PROVE AGNode(s)'
  BY <1>3, AGDisjoint, NullPointNotServer, SMTT("r10")
   DEF AGInv, AGCluster, AGNode, IsLeader, LeaderShutdown,
       ZabTimeoutInCluster, InitialConnectInfo, LEADING, FOLLOWING,
       LOOKING
<1>4. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, SMTT("r5")
   DEF AGInv, AGCluster, AGShape, AGNode

LEMMA AGShutdownFollower ==
  ASSUME NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server, AGInv,
         IsLeader(i), IsFollower(j), IsMyLeader(j,i),
         FollowerShutdown(j), RemoveLearner(i,j)
  PROVE AGInv'
<1>1. AGShape'
  <2>1. AGShape
    BY SMTT("r2") DEF AGInv, AGCluster, AGShape
  <2>2. QED
    BY <2>1, SMTT("r10")
     DEF AGShape, FollowerShutdown, ZabTimeout, RemoveLearner,
         InitialConnectInfo
<1>2. AGNode(j)'
  BY NullPointNotServer, SMTT("r5")
   DEF AGInv, AGCluster, AGNode, IsLeader, IsFollower, IsMyLeader,
       FollowerShutdown, ZabTimeout, RemoveLearner, InitialConnectInfo,
       LEADING, FOLLOWING, LOOKING
<1>3. AGNode(i)'
  BY NullPointNotServer, SMTT("r5")
   DEF AGInv, AGCluster, AGNode, IsLeader, IsFollower, IsMyLeader,
       FollowerShutdown, ZabTimeout, RemoveLearner, InitialConnectInfo,
       LEADING, FOLLOWING, LOOKING
<1>4. ASSUME NEW s \in Server, s /= i, s /= j
      PROVE AGNode(s)'
  BY <1>4, AGDisjoint, NullPointNotServer, SMTT("r10")
   DEF AGInv, AGCluster, AGNode, IsLeader, IsFollower, IsMyLeader,
       FollowerShutdown, ZabTimeout, RemoveLearner, InitialConnectInfo,
       LEADING, FOLLOWING, LOOKING
<1>5. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, SMTT("r5")
   DEF AGInv, AGCluster, AGShape, AGNode

LEMMA AGMinOne == Minimum({1}) = 1
BY SMTT("r5") DEF Minimum

\* Base cases for all nine target properties.
LEMMA AGInitialSafety ==
  Init => /\ Leadership1 /\ Leadership2 /\ PrefixConsistency
          /\ Integrity /\ Agreement /\ TotalOrder /\ LocalPrimaryOrder
          /\ GlobalPrimaryOrder /\ PrimaryIntegrity
<1>1. Init => Leadership1
  BY SMTT("r5")
   DEF Init, InitServerVars, InitServerVarsL, Leadership1, IsLeader,
       LOOKING, LEADING
<1>2. Init => Leadership2
  BY AGCardBridge, AGFinite!FS_EmptySet, SMTT("r5")
   DEF Init, InitVerifyVars, Leadership2
<1>3. Init => PrefixConsistency
  <2>1. Init => \A i,j \in Server:
          /\ {lastCommitted[i].index, lastCommitted[j].index} = {1}
          /\ history[i] = history[j]
    BY SMTT("r5")
     DEF Init, InitServerVars, InitServerVarsL
  <2>2. QED
    BY <2>1, AGMinOne, SMTT("r5")
     DEF PrefixConsistency, TxnEqual, ZxidEqual
<1>4. Init => Integrity
  BY SMTT("r5")
   DEF Init, InitServerVars, InitServerVarsL, Integrity, IsFollower,
       LOOKING, FOLLOWING
<1>5. Init => Agreement
  BY SMTT("r5")
   DEF Init, InitServerVars, InitServerVarsL, Agreement, IsFollower,
       LOOKING, FOLLOWING
<1>6. Init => TotalOrder
  BY SMTT("r5")
   DEF Init, InitServerVars, TotalOrder
<1>7. Init => LocalPrimaryOrder
  BY SMTT("r5")
   DEF Init, InitServerVars, InitServerVarsL, LocalPrimaryOrder
<1>8. Init => GlobalPrimaryOrder
  BY SMTT("r5")
   DEF Init, InitServerVars, GlobalPrimaryOrder
<1>9. Init => PrimaryIntegrity
  BY SMTT("r5")
   DEF Init, InitServerVars, InitServerVarsL, PrimaryIntegrity,
       IsLeader, LOOKING, LEADING
<1>10. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5, <1>6, <1>7, <1>8, <1>9

LEMMA AGMinimumPair ==
  \A a,b \in Nat: Minimum({a,b}) = IF a <= b THEN a ELSE b
<1>1. ASSUME NEW a \in Nat, NEW b \in Nat, a <= b
      PROVE Minimum({a,b}) = a
  BY <1>1, SMTT("r5") DEF Minimum
<1>2. ASSUME NEW a \in Nat, NEW b \in Nat, ~(a <= b)
      PROVE Minimum({a,b}) = b
  BY <1>2, SMTT("r5") DEF Minimum
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, SMTT("r5")

         \A s \in Server: lastCommitted[s].index \in Nat
  PROVE Agreement
BY AGMinimumPair, SMTT("r10")
